description.value: Burgoo is a neighbourhood comfort food bistro that opened its original Point Grey location in December 2001, built around an old-world countryside ambience with earth tones and natural finishes. The menu leans into hearty, warming dishes — French onion soup, mac and cheese, poutine, and stacked sandwiches — the kind of substantial food a cyclist finishing a long ride through Vancouver's west side would welcome. It is one of three Burgoo locations in Vancouver and accepts both dine-in and pick-up orders, with delivery also available through third-party apps.
